protocol.name: rd_owned_buffer_v1
protocol.copyright: Isolated experimental protocol. No native Mach/IOSurface rights cross this Wayland socket. Not enabled in the default Hyprland session.

interface.name: rd_owned_buffer_v1

description.summary: Owned native frame capability to wl_buffer

interface.description: The session host broker registers an owned window token and approved guest client identity before use. This manager creates wl_buffer resources for completed frame sequences. The token is an opaque 16-byte capability, not an IOSurface ID or native pointer. The compositor releases a frame with wl_buffer.release after the GPU has stopped sampling it; a client must not reuse its producer slot sooner.

entry.name: stale
entry.summary: frame sequence unavailable or already leased
